onboarding1Body: Every morning DailyMB collects the day's 5 answers from several public sites and cross-checks them. Two sites must agree before an answer is marked verified.
onboarding2Body: A missing day resets your streak. Allow notifications so you get the answers at 6:00 AM and a reminder in the evening if you have not claimed yet.
onboarding3Title: Keep the app awake on Android
onboarding3Body: On Android, open your phone Settings, find DailyMB under Apps, and set Battery to Unrestricted. This keeps the morning notification reliable.
